summary: Vercel still targets a previous Quick Tunnel after cloudflared is restarted.
steps_to_reproduce: Restart cloudflared; open deployed login on a computer without a local companion; attempt sign-in before updating Vercel.
expected_result: The deployed frontend connects to the running API.
actual_result: Network Error; live bundle contained pieces-larry-buses-dock while running tunnel was following-functions-merry-lake.
fix_reference: Vercel production VITE_API_BASE updated and redeployed; start_remote_access.bat added
retest_result: Login returned 200 and dashboard rendered with loopback requests blocked.

summary: Compiled temporary API address becomes stale again after a tunnel restart.
steps_to_reproduce: Open deployed login without a companion after the public tunnel address changes and before updating the frontend.
expected_result: One startup command verifies deployed API access before sharing the site.
actual_result: Live bundle targeted following-functions-merry-lake while the running tunnel advertised mom-upgrading-capital-wines.
fix_reference: Fixed same-origin /api route; route updates without rebuild; start_production.bat readiness checks
retest_result: Remote sign-in and orchard read returned 200; zero failed API requests; repeated launcher run exited 0 without rebuilding.

summary: First Funnel activation outlasts the initial 90-second deployed readiness budget.
steps_to_reproduce: Enable a new Funnel and publish its Vercel API route; open the app before the launcher reports readiness.
expected_result: Setup allows initial activation time and reports ready only after healthy deployed API access.
actual_result: Initial browser health received a non-JSON upstream response and the 90-second launcher wait expired; no share-ready message or saved connection was produced.
reproduces: Observed during initial activation; exact upstream cause not captured
fix_reference: Stable setup waits up to 600 seconds; saved settings require healthy deployed API and login preflight
retest_result: Setup and normal/read-only launchers exited 0; production login and orchard read HTTP 200; a new cold Funnel activation was not repeated.

summary: Groupmate local companion health does not allow the Vercel origin.
steps_to_reproduce: On the affected laptop open deployed MangoPoint; attempt offline simulation; request local health with the deployed site Origin header.
expected_result: Healthy companion returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin for the deployed site and browser uses the local API.
actual_result: User reports healthy API and connected database but no Local-first banner; corrected PowerShell check returns blank Allowed origin.
reproduces: Yes; blank header confirmed by user
status: Repair prepared; affected laptop retest pending
fix_reference: start_offline_companion.bat -RepairCors; preserve existing settings and recreate API-only container
retest_result: Not executed on affected laptop; repair tested with temporary fixtures and Docker mocks.

summary: Production launcher repeatedly reads the large deployed bundle and stalls at download progress.
steps_to_reproduce: Run the original production connection launcher against the already running server; observe the kilobyte display before later checks.
expected_result: Unchanged deployed app configuration is reused and startup shows clear stage messages while preserving readiness checks.
actual_result: Original read-only diagnostic was interrupted after 309.29 seconds at bundle checking; intermediate progress-only/cache change completed in 174.4 seconds.
status: Fixed; prepared-laptop startup and remote login retest passed
fix_reference: Text-only bounded bundle download; hashed-release configuration cache; stage messages; retained health/login checks
retest_result: Normal launcher 9.6 seconds; forced fresh bundle check 1.4 seconds; remote login and orchard GET HTTP 200.
